negative_controls.command:
python3 -c "import asyncio, os, signal, time
async def main():
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    proc = await asyncio.create_subprocess_shell('sleep 6', stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE, stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE, start_new_session=True)
    try:
        await asyncio.wait_for(proc.communicate(), timeout=0.3)
    except asyncio.TimeoutError:
        try:
            os.killpg(os.getpgid(proc.pid), signal.SIGKILL)
        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError, OSError):
            proc.kill()
        await proc.wait()
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
    assert elapsed < 2, f'process-group kill should bound wall-clock time, elapsed={elapsed:.2f}s'
asyncio.run(main())
"
negative_controls.name: process-group-kill-bounds-walltime
